arguments.sql_query:
WITH t2dm_dx AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
     AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826  -- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), adults AS (
    SELECT d.person_id, d.index_date
    FROM t2dm_dx d
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = d.person_id
    WHERE DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, 1, 1), d.index_date) >= 18
), antidiabetic_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21600712  -- ATC: Drugs used in diabetes
), post_dx_drugs AS (
    SELECT a.person_id,
           de.drug_exposure_start_date,
           de.drug_concept_id
    FROM adults a
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
      ON de.person_id = a.person_id
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= a.index_date
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, a.index_date)
    JOIN antidiabetic_drugs ad
      ON ad.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
), first_start AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM post_dx_drugs
    GROUP BY person_id
), first_drugs AS (
    SELECT p.person_id, p.drug_concept_id
    FROM post_dx_drugs p
    JOIN first_start f
      ON f.person_id = p.person_id
     AND f.first_drug_date = p.drug_exposure_start_date
), ingredients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fd.person_id, ing.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, ing.concept_name AS ingredient_name
    FROM first_drugs fd
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor cai
      ON cai.descendant_concept_id = fd.drug_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ing
      ON ing.concept_id = cai.ancestor_concept_id
     AND ing.domain_id = 'Drug'
     AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
)
SELECT TOP 10 ingredient_name, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients_started_first
FROM ingredients
GROUP BY ingredient_name
ORDER BY patients_started_first DESC;

WITH t2dm_dx AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
      ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
     AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
    GROUP BY co.person_id
), adults AS (
    SELECT d.person_id, d.index_date
    FROM t2dm_dx d
    JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = d.person_id
    WHERE DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, 1, 1), d.index_date) >= 18
), antidiabetic_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 21600712
), post_dx_drugs AS (
    SELECT a.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_concept_id
    FROM adults a
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
      ON CAST(de.person_id AS int) = a.person_id
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= a.index_date
     AND de.drug_exposure_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 180, a.index_date)
    JOIN antidiabetic_drugs ad ON ad.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
), first_start AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS first_drug_date
    FROM post_dx_drugs
    GROUP BY person_id
), first_drugs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id, p.drug_concept_id
    FROM post_dx_drugs p
    JOIN first_start f ON f.person_id = p.person_id AND f.first_drug_date = p.drug_exposure_start_date
), rxnorm_ingredients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fd.person_id, ing.concept_id, ing.concept_name
    FROM first_drugs fd
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor cai ON cai.descendant_concept_id = fd.drug_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept ing ON ing.concept_id = cai.ancestor_concept_id
    WHERE ing.domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
      AND ing.vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND ing.standard_concept = 'S'
)
SELECT TOP 10 concept_id, concept_name AS medication, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients_started_first
FROM rxnorm_ingredients
GROUP BY concept_id, concept_name
ORDER BY patients_started_first DESC;

Among adults with newly diagnosed T2DM, the three most commonly first-started antidiabetic medications were:

1. **Insulin aspart, human** — 21,173 patients  
2. **Metformin** — 7,329 patients  
3. **Insulin glargine** — 5,512 patients  

I defined “first started” as the earliest antidiabetic drug exposure within 180 days after the patient’s first recorded T2DM diagnosis, restricted to adults at diagnosis.
